name: Software Engineer
responsibilities: Design, develop, and modify software systems, and own the testing, validation, and documentation that prove they work
Analyze user needs and software requirements to judge whether a design is feasible within real time and cost constraints
Modify existing software to correct errors, adapt it to new hardware, and improve its performance
skills: Systems analysis and evaluation: tracing how a change in one component ripples through the rest of the system before you ship it
Fluency with the working toolchain: development environments, object oriented languages, and file versioning (git) as daily habits
Designing, querying, and managing the databases inside your application, not treating data as someone else's job
Conferring with analysts, engineers, and customers to pin down performance requirements and interfaces, then holding the system to them
